I will put some urea on this plot that I received from our farmers' cooperative, because the land needs help to produce well, and I will also spread cattle manure since I have animals at home. I have kept good sorghum seed from my own harvest last year, so I will plant that rather than buying expensive improved seed. This plot is small enough that my family can do all the work—planting, weeding, and harvesting—so I will not hire outside labor, and we do not have irrigation water here anyway. Sorghum is strong and does not need chemicals for pests, so I will not spray anything.
